title: Jonah and the Summer
author: Wendell Villalobos
blurb: Ansel Quintana, a vineyard owner who inherited debts instead of grapes, has spent three years rebuilding a life measured in small safe steps. But when a snowstorm strands two rivals with the best mistake of their twenties, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the vineyard's first harvest comes in.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
